purpose: Machine-readable mapping from active and pipeline-relevant requirements to current modules/functions, coverage status, evidence paths, and next action.

scope_boundary.notes: This matrix records requirement-to-module coverage only. It does not register missing refs, acquire sources, parse/chunk articles, perform KG import, write LadybugDB, activate DSPy/RLM/MiniMax behavior, or promote trusted facts. Future/out-of-scope and unsafe-to-claim classifications are preserved from M027/M028 scope matrices.

coverage_status_legend.covered: Current module/function surface and evidence directly cover the bounded requirement aspect listed in this row.
coverage_status_legend.supported: The requirement is already validated or externally scoped, and current artifacts provide supporting evidence only.
coverage_status_legend.partial: Some pipeline modules exist and have evidence, but the full requirement remains active until future canonical validation.
coverage_status_legend.blocked: Pipeline module exists, but upstream artifacts or required validation are missing for M030 requested refs.
coverage_status_legend.future_out_of_scope: Requirement remains active and intentionally outside the bounded M030 static architecture/readiness scope.
coverage_status_legend.gated_future_scope: Requirement remains active, but any model/helper/optimizer activation is explicitly gated by future fixtures, metrics, and safety checks.
coverage_status_legend.unsafe_to_claim: Current code is a fail-closed boundary only; positive import/write/readiness claims are unsafe.

requirements.requirement_summary: Hybrid retrieval must return traceable evidence contexts with vector, graph, fusion score metadata, and EvidencePath references.
requirements.next_action: Keep active for a future retrieval validation milestone with vector-only, graph expansion, fused retrieval, score metadata, and EvidencePath comparison tests.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim M030 validates hybrid retrieval.
Do not claim graph readiness or trusted fact promotion.

requirements.requirement_summary: RLM document navigation and workflow-in-code prototypes must be read-only, bounded, typed, and deterministically validated.
requirements.next_action: Keep active until bounded read-only RLM workflow fixtures prove typed draft outputs, trajectory capture, and deterministic validation.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim RLM activation.
Do not claim model helper outputs are authoritative.

requirements.requirement_summary: RLM graph traversal must be benchmarked against deterministic retrieval baselines before adoption recommendations.
requirements.next_action: Keep active for a future comparative benchmark covering vector-only, one-hop graph expansion, heuristic BFS, adaptive traversal, cost, latency, and recall.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim RLM traversal adoption readiness.
Do not claim graph traversal beats deterministic baselines.

requirements.requirement_summary: Scientific KG behavior must be validated on staged real article batches of 10 documents, 20 documents, then one-week corpus with graph quality analysis.
requirements.next_action: Treat M027/M028 as partial preprocessing/smoke evidence only; run staged KG validation with graph-quality review before changing requirement status.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim staged KG behavior is validated.
Do not claim M030 requested refs are graph-ready.

requirements.requirement_summary: Converted paper data and chunks must satisfy graph-readiness quality covering fidelity, normalization, semantics, table/figure handling, section hierarchy, and provenance.
requirements.next_action: Replay M030 source acquisition and parser/conversion for selected refs, then run graph-readiness quality benchmark before any positive readiness claim.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim parser_ready or chunk_ready for M030 requested refs before replay evidence exists.
Do not claim graph-readiness acceptance.

requirements.requirement_summary: Chunking must produce import-ready typed chunk packages with stable IDs, source spans, lineage, routes, quality states, deterministic annotations, and independent review evidence.
requirements.next_action: Keep active until import-ready typed packages pass independent review and fail-closed import contract checks; M030 static readiness is not positive import readiness.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim import_ready=true.
Do not claim independent semantic review exists for M030 refs.

requirements.requirement_summary: Validation must expand to a 30-paper deviation scan before broader chunking/import-readiness conclusions.
requirements.next_action: Keep active for a future 30-paper deviation scan with distributions, outliers, missing-source rates, route/refusal patterns, and no-import recommendations.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim 30-paper scan completion from M030 static architecture evidence.

requirements.requirement_summary: Corpus validation must support automated +10-paper iterative loops up to 100 papers with resumable state, acquisition, deviation analysis, remediation, and no-import/no-write gates.
requirements.next_action: Keep active until an automated resumable +10 loop persists manifests, diagnostics, reports, baselines, and review gates without KG writes.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim unattended scaling or +10 loop support from M030 static matrices.

requirements.requirement_summary: Provide deterministic, resumable CLI workflow for iterative +10-paper validation batches toward a 100-paper diagnostic corpus.
requirements.next_action: Keep active until CLI commands select next batches, preflight/acquire sources, run redacted scans, compare deltas, flag blockers, and persist resumable batch state.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim deterministic 100-paper validation workflow readiness from M030 static evidence.

requirements.requirement_summary: Validation batches must fill target accepted-paper quota using deterministic replacement candidates when selected papers cannot become source-ready within bounded acquisition rules.
requirements.next_action: Preserve R035 as active; a future validation-batch milestone must materialize deterministic replacements and prove target quota or explicit shortage blocker.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim M030 or M028 fully validates R035.
Do not claim deterministic replacement materialization or validation-batch quota top-up has been delivered.

requirements.requirement_summary: Generated artifacts must preserve provenance with command, inputs, outputs, hashes, exit status, cwd/git context, and milestone/batch context.
requirements.next_action: Preserve validated status and continue requiring command/input/output hash and context provenance for future generated artifact classes.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim M030 newly validates all future provenance workflows globally.
Do not claim production write authorization.

requirements.requirement_summary: New infrastructure must be researched, compatibility-probed, and safety-wrapped before enabling it in the main Scientific KG process.
requirements.next_action: Keep active as a project-wide constraint; require future infrastructure work to include research/probe artifacts, redaction boundaries, failure-mode analysis, and explicit go/no-go decisions.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not treat safety preservation as permission to enable model helpers, graph writes, production persistence, or KG import.

requirements.requirement_summary: Provide deterministic CLI for detecting article structure artifacts and candidate KG scaffold links from preserved paper sources without KG import.
requirements.next_action: Keep active until a deterministic pre-KG CLI emits artifact manifests, stable IDs, source spans, candidate links, review states, provenance, and kg_import_allowed=false.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim article artifact detection CLI is delivered by M030 S04.
Do not claim candidate KG scaffolds are importable.

requirements.requirement_summary: MiniMax may assist article artifact detection only as bounded structured helper with forced tool calls, local schema validation, redacted inputs, and non-authoritative outputs.
requirements.next_action: Keep active and gated until tests/fixtures prove forced tool-call shape, local schema validation, redacted diagnostics, non-authoritative outputs, and no KG import authorization.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim MiniMax activation.
Do not claim MiniMax output is source-of-truth or importable.

requirements.requirement_summary: DSPy prompt optimization for artifact detection must remain gated until benchmark fixtures, metrics, and baseline outputs exist.
requirements.next_action: Keep active and gated until benchmark fixtures and metrics compare deterministic/MiniMax baselines before any DSPy optimizer activation recommendation.
unsafe_claims_to_preserve: Do not claim DSPy or optimizer activation.
Do not claim prompt optimization readiness without benchmark evidence.

verification_contract.expected_result: JSON parses as a single object with 15 requirement rows and preserved fail-closed scope classifications.
